# libspng / spng_read_fuzzer

libspng's own fuzz target `spng_read_fuzzer` ([source](source/spng_read_fuzzer.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libspng (randy408/libspng at adc94393).

Checks 3 properties (listed below); the first, an invariant: Every tEXt/zTXt/iTXt entry spng_get_text returns has non-NULL text, language_tag and translated_keyword, a non-empty keyword, and a NUL within the 80-byte keyword field; then strlen(text) is computed as a further read check.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libspng at commit adc94393.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- Every tEXt/zTXt/iTXt entry spng_get_text returns has non-NULL text, language_tag and translated_keyword, a non-empty keyword, and a NUL within the 80-byte keyword field; then strlen(text) is computed as a further read check ([lines 115-135](source/spng_read_fuzzer.c#L115-L135)): returns only; not confirmed in the binary.
- Every sPLT entry has a non-empty name, a non-NULL entries array and a NUL within the 80-byte name field ([lines 141-157](source/spng_read_fuzzer.c#L141-L157)): returns only; not confirmed in the binary.
- Every unknown chunk kept by SPNG_KEEP_UNKNOWN_CHUNKS has data != NULL iff length != 0 ([lines 159-174](source/spng_read_fuzzer.c#L159-L174)): returns only; not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libspng` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `spng_read_fuzzer.plain` | 113,752 | `f6fd9021f82a2a7c72fba4b16932ad90e9b4f0f0c17b9772cb530f704819709d` |
| ubsan | `spng_read_fuzzer.ubsan` | 120,840 | `be258f899bc0b4aad54e6ff1d909852cf170ba6eef1f9b57e446c0d56377816d` |
| asan | `spng_read_fuzzer.asan` | 696,904 | `34a3a17cb4eb0f02180b60fbd59aa5bd1cff823099aa17875c3e587bc96556b4` |
| asan-ubsan | `spng_read_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 702,664 | `32da9b23b7d1d4bfbdd3de2cd442c9325f0bb53430ea99cdfe827744634232e5` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
